question: When was the Golden Gate Bridge opened?
ground_truth: The Golden Gate Bridge was opened in 1937.
ground_truth_context: It was opened in 1937 and was once the longest and tallest suspension bridge in the world.

question: Why was the International Orange color chosen for the Golden Gate Bridge?
